title: artnetsend
description: `artnetsend` takes a list of integer DMX values and prepends an Art-Net v4 ArtDmx header, producing raw bytes for later UDP transmission. Its universe (0–32768) and physical (0–255) values are settable, while the sequence number is stamped automatically; direct input lists must contain a multiple of two items because `artnetsend` does not validate or correct their length.
